enchantments.tooltip: Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Insightful Will Save +2: This item gives a +2 Insight bonus to your Will saves.
Seeker +12: Provides a +12 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +12 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
